_comment: ClearShelf Zetaris objects, in onboarding order (gateway/onboard.py runs them). Each create script has a _select.sql verification pair. Status is from the Day-0 gate run on 2026-10-23 against Zetaris 2.4.3.1 (local Docker). The user-agent placeholder in REST scripts is replaced from CLEARSHELF_USER_AGENT at run time.

sources.summary: Lightning databases CLEARSHELF_OFF, CLEARSHELF_FDA, CLEARSHELF_FSA, CLEARSHELF_OPS, the SchemaStore container clearshelf and the USL namespace lightning.metastore.clearshelf
openFDA food enforcement reports mentioning undeclared, latest 1,000 (one request), cached. Public domain / CC0
UK FSA allergy alerts, latest 200, double explode to alert x allergen, cached. Open Government Licence v3.0
Ops store served by nginx (ops/docker-compose.ops.yml) as http://clearshelf-ops on zetaris_default: health, market_allergens, decisions, recall_links, extractions. Never cached
Open Food Facts product tables, one per SKU in data/manifest/skus.json, generated by gateway/onboard.py (CREATE, DESCRIBE, CACHE; 5 s between calls that reach Open Food Facts). ODbL 1.0
USL clearance_usl: nine tables with keys and foreign keys, compiled as one statement, with descriptions
Activations of all nine tables from the raw REST tables, generated by gateway/onboard.py; product and declared_allergen per SKU from the manifest and zetaris/off_describe.json
Custom DQ rules has_ingredients, english_label (product) and known_relation (extracted_allergen); PK and FK rules come from the DDL
Gate probe: re-ACTIVATE product with a changed query (2 SKUs, then 3)
DQ rules and read queries for the ops decision write-back on the USL decision table
